notes.title: All Games Free & Patreon
notes.content:
Hello, to anyone reading this.

I'm no longer planning to make any video games or visual novels for the time being.  I'm focusing on making interactive and non-interactive fiction.  You can find more and buy into all my content (more coming, of course) on my Patreon: patreon.com/Cleril

I only have one membership tier, $1, for everything.

I'll eventually be posting a demo of my interactive fiction, Mercenary, and I post new short stories at least once a month (launched just last week and already two short stories are available).

I also make board games which I may integrate into that Patreon or make a different Patreon just for that.  Currently working on a Factory Roll & Write game.

With that, I decided to make all of my steam titles completely free. I haven't made more than 100 bucks on them in years. Thanks to all of you who purchased them previously.

You can find me on itch.io as well where I'll post Mercenary when its ready for a demo:  https://itch.io/profile/cleril

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Haeven Permanent Price Reduction
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25810402/52ff495140dea3be430d2e53f4b92a526bb9b5c3.png[/img]

Howdy folks, just wanted to announce that Haeven will permanently be 0.99USD forevermore.  I've honestly been too lazy to bother putting it on sale (usually for 49 cents, the lowest steam allows) and figure I might as well just drop it down to allow myself to be lazy.  I don't work on video games or visual novels anymore (I was working on another visual novel years ago but never finished it).  I may get back into such things in the distant future but for now I work on 3D printed board game components.

If interested I have a visual novel on Steam in case you missed it; which was always a dollar:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/713860/My_Name_is_Addiction/

And if you want to check out my etsy store where I sell 3D printed board game upgrades: https://www.etsy.com/uk/shop/CalamitousArt/

I haven't had the time and/or desire to work on games or visual novels for several years.  But it could always happen.  For now, maybe consider picking up what I left behind for as low as Valve lets me sell it.  Besides being free of course; I'm too greedy for that.

notes.title: Name Change Explaination
notes.content:
The Game Bakers (devs behind Furi) contacted me asking for a name change for reasons I'm not at liberty to disclose.  We came to an agreement and so here we are as my game will now be called "Haeven."

Only the store page and main title image of the game has been altered in the update that went through.  No game content has been changed.

notes.title: Buy The Calamitous Bundle - Get MNIA for Free!
notes.content:
Now that the launch sales are done I've adjusted the bundle discount from 12% to 17% making it so if you want to buy Haven you might as well get the bundle as it includes MNIA for free and shaves off a few pennies from Haven.  Plus any and all future titles of mine will be available via the bundle and you'll only pay for what you don't own with an inherent 17% discount on top of whatever sales might exist!

Consumer loyalty means a lot to me.  I want anyone who enjoys any titles of mine to be rewarded for that.  I hope you're looking forward to future releases (see my twitter for some artwork of my next title, Duel): https://twitter.com/ClerilCalamity

notes.title: Noteworthy Patch
notes.content:
Just wanted to let folks know I found out the ending of the game wasn't functioning properly and therefore you couldn't even fight the final boss.  I believe I fixed everything but should you be unable to fight the final boss or the game seems to end rather oddly without any real explanation let me know.

This patch was done yesterday but I didn't get a chance to announce it until today.
